property_summary: After a successful call to newEmergencyOracle, the emitted event NewEmergencyOracle always contains the caller's address as the owner parameter; the buggy modifier causes every call to revert, so the event is never emitted.

For any caller address and any description, a call to newEmergencyOracle must NOT revert when the caller equals jojoTeam; the buggy modifier always reverts, so a call by the jojoTeam will revert in the mutant but succeed in the reference.
For any sender and description, if the sender equals jojoTeam, the transaction will succeed in the reference but revert in the mutant; otherwise both revert.
For any caller and description, if msg.sender is jojoTeam then newEmergencyOracle succeeds and emits NewEmergencyOracle with the caller as owner; the buggy modifier makes it revert for the jojoTeam.
For any caller and description, calling newEmergencyOracle succeeds if and only if the caller is the jojoTeam; the buggy modifier makes it always revert for the jojoTeam.
